records.name: crm.partner.report.assign.select
records.declaration:
<field name="arch" type="xml">
                <search string="Partner assigned Analysis">
                    <field name="user_id"/>
                    <field name="grade_id"/>
                    <field name="activation"/>
                    <filter name="filter_date_partnership" date="date_partnership"/>
                    <filter name="filter_date_review" date="date_review"/>
                    <group>
                        <filter string="Salesperson" name="user" context="{'group_by':'user_id'}"/>
                        <filter string="Partner" name="partner" context="{'group_by':'partner_id'}"/>
                        <separator/>
                        <filter string="Date Partnership" name="group_date_partnership" context="{'group_by':'date_partnership'}"/>
                        <filter string="Date Review" name="group_date_review" context="{'group_by':'date_review'}"/>
                    </group>
                </search>
            </field>

records.name: crm.partner.assign.report.graph
records.declaration:
<field name="arch" type="xml">
                <graph string="Opportunities Assignment Analysis" sample="1" disable_linking="1">
                    <field name="grade_id"/>
                    <field name="nbr_opportunities" type="measure"/>
                    <field name="turnover" type="measure"/>
                </graph>
            </field>
